title: RAS utils
description: Shared sub-schemas reused by the RAS per-type documents (resistor, varistor, thermistor; potentiometer reuses `thermal` and `deratingCurve` but not `mechanical`). The `part` block is per-type (technology enums differ) — thermal, mechanical and deratingCurve are shared here. NOTE: `mechanical` is SEALED and therefore cannot be extended; a type needing extra mechanical fields (potentiometer: shaft, mounting, actuation) composes the PEAS mechanical base directly instead.

thermal.title: rasThermal
thermal.description: Thermal characteristics — extends PEAS datasheetInfoThermal with body-to-ambient thermal resistance.

thermalResistance.description: Thermal resistance from body to ambient, in K/W.

mechanical.title: rasMechanical
mechanical.description: Mechanical specs — extends PEAS datasheetInfoMechanical with a package case field.

pinout.description: Per-terminal function map (shared PEAS type, hoisted 2026-08). Rarely needed for 2-terminal parts; real for current-sense 4-terminal (Kelvin) resistors and resistor networks.

landPattern.description: Manufacturer-recommended PCB land pattern (shared PEAS type, hoisted 2026-08).

deratingCurve.title: deratingCurve
deratingCurve.description: Power / current / voltage derating curve as paired arrays. Index-aligned: amplitude[i] is the rated fraction at temperature[i].

amplitude.description: Derating fraction (0..1) at each temperature breakpoint.
